Bridge restoration photo diary

The restoration team photographed the footbridge at the end of each working day. These images document how workers removed the damaged boards, inspected the supports and fitted the replacement deck. Residents can follow the sequence without entering the construction area beside the river.

The photographs also show details that are difficult to see from the path. Engineers marked the joints before fastening the new boards, then recorded the measurements for the final inspection. The project diary will remain available after the bridge opens so maintenance crews can review the work.

The final inspection will compare the completed structure with the approved drawings. Until that visit is complete, the temporary diversion stays in place and the public should continue using the signed path. A further diary entry will report the inspection results and the reopening date.
